review_type: single AI curator; complete final answer personally read; identity visible; original scientific-quality rubric

errors.quote: across independent library preparations of the same cells
errors.issue: Destructive joint assays on split aliquots observe different cells. The later per-cell residual ICC has no defined repeated-cell matching or aggregate estimand; replicate-aliquot variability is not purely technical variance.

errors.quote: standardized by the pooled technical variance from the noise model and replicate aliquots
errors.issue: Marginal count/background models and variation among different cells do not identify a joint technical-discordance null. RNA measurement error and underlying biological covariance require explicit calibration/model assumptions.

errors.quote: flow cytometry with the matched clone
errors.issue: A different readout using the same clone can retain the same specificity error. It validates part of tag detection, not antigen identity or same-cell RNA/protein discordance. The later non-overlapping-epitope caveat is useful but not implemented as the primary validation.

errors.quote: shifts RNA and protein equally (technical gain change)
errors.issue: Coordinated changes in RNA and protein can be genuine biology. Equal shifts are not diagnostic of technical gain, particularly when the modalities use different scales.

errors.quote: the optimal integrated representation is denoising-based
errors.issue: Artifact-like discordance does not establish which integration model is optimal. Phase4 has no locked donor holdout, precise external criterion, fitted implementation or adequate unimodal/fixed-weight comparisons.

errors.quote: the orthogonal assay confirms the protein levels implied by the tag measurement in the discordant cells
errors.issue: Matched aliquots provide different cells and protein-only marginal validation. They cannot by themselves establish the original same-cell joint distribution or a discrete functional state.

errors.quote: a count model capturing dropout and mean–dispersion
errors.issue: The actual model/normalization, target system, key staining parameters, perturbation identity/time grid and quantitative sample-size rationale are deferred. The proposal supplies useful structure but cannot yet be executed or audited numerically.

rationale: Relevant biological-discordance alternative with donors, randomized processing, controls and perturbation follow-up. The central replicate/null definition and orthogonal-validation claims need substantial correction. Feature-level discordance-axis recommendations are not learned cell-specific multimodal neighborhoods; historical direction does not qualify.
reference_guardrails: Complete final answer, packet, reference and sealed target personally read. Original rubric only; strict-round penalties not active.
Cell-specific learned modality utility and an explicit integrated neighborhood construction are essential for this historical target; generic calibrated weighting or a graph mention is insufficient.
Donor splitting must precede fitted transformations and tuning. Condition blinding does not replace independent endpoint validation or prevent marker-label circularity.

A technical-null mismatch need not define a new cell state. Low-count/QC correlation does not prove artifact. Use known-control calibration, independent phenotypes and quantitative sensitivity analyses.
